summary: Iteration 3 frontend testing complete. All 12 requested features verified successfully on both desktop (1440x900) and mobile (390x844) viewports. Hero visual refresh (animated gradient, warm pill, Instrument Serif italic emphasis), mobile tap-to-expand cards, palette shift, compacted section headings, and all regression flows (contact API, marquee, carbon clock) all pass.

issues: Element ID '#hero-root' referenced in review request does not exist in DOM; the hero H1 works correctly regardless (single H1 on page). Consider adding id='hero-root' to hero wrapper for testability/consistency with spec.
